## Purpose

Describe how BNR confirms that an event record is sufficiently complete, internally consistent and authorised for inclusion in a routine data release.

## Procedure to complete

1. Confirm that the record meets the registry inclusion and event-definition rules.
2. Confirm that required abstraction and REDCap forms are complete.
3. Review unresolved queries, duplicate status and important missing outcomes.
4. Confirm that dates and key classifications are internally consistent.
5. Return the record for correction if a required check fails.
6. Record the approval status, approver role and date in the agreed location.
7. Include the approved record in the next eligible data release.

## BNR details to add

- whether approval is record-level, form-level or status-based;
- the mandatory checks;
- who may approve;
- whether the data entrant may also approve;
- which issues prevent approval; and
- how an approved record is reopened after correction.
